div.ab: (Aus Lp: In hac eadem carta ponuntur eadem uerba Anglico sermone uerbo ad uerbum.)
In hac eadem carta ponuntur eadem verba Anglico sermone verbo ad verbum.
In this same document the same words are put in the English tongue, word for word.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 236–237 (text and translation); In ... verbum: only in Lp (Robertson).; Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 485, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

diese Zeile citirt ähnlich ‘et continetur in Regis[tro] episc. London.’ aus Lib. ms. arch. Cant[uariensis] Spelman bei Wilkins Leg. Sax. 293. [Dies Canterbury-Ms. ruht also auf Lp.] Er druckt auch die Londoner Adresse daraus, mit zwei Fehlern gegen Lp.

this line is cited in similar form, ‘et continetur in Regis[tro] episc. London.’, from Lib. ms. arch. Cant[uariensis] by Spelman in Wilkins Leg. Sax. 293. [This Canterbury MS therefore rests on Lp.] He also prints the London address from it, with two errors as against Lp.
